description: This file defines an abstract PHP class 'AbstractMetaDataImplementation' that serves as a base for handling module metadata in SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM. It contains methods for loading, saving, and managing view definitions and layout configurations related to modules, supporting different storage locations and formats. The class employs patterns for managing view metadata such as list views, edit views, and popup views within the SuiteCRM module development framework.

classes.name: AbstractMetaDataImplementation
classes.description: Abstract class providing mechanisms to load, save, and manipulate module view definitions and metadata files within the SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM framework.

methods.name: getViewdefs
methods.description: Returns the loaded view definitions for the module.

methods.name: getOriginalViewdefs
methods.description: Returns the original view definitions loaded from the metadata files.

methods.name: getOriginalViewTemplateDefinitions
methods.description: Returns the original view template definitions.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Provides access to the history object for the layout.

methods.name: _loadFromFile
methods.description: Loads a view layout definition from a specified PHP file.

methods.name: _loadFromPopupFile
methods.description: Loads popup view layout definitions, with optional support for non-popup views.

methods.name: _saveToFile
methods.description: Saves the layout definitions to a PHP file, optionally including variable placeholders.

methods.name: hasToAppendOriginalViewTemplateDefs
methods.description: Determines if original view template definitions should be appended when saving.

methods.name: _mergeFielddefs
methods.description: Merges layout fields into existing field definitions, overriding as necessary.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Generates the filename for metadata, based on view, module, package, and location.

methods.name: getFileNameInPackage
methods.description: Constructs a path to the module's metadata file within a specified package and location.

methods.name: getModuleDir
methods.description: Returns the directory path of the module.
